name: garas-transportation-backend
description: Garas Employee Transportation Management System — backend (NestJS + Prisma + SQL Server). Replicates the documented CoreApi contract.

scripts.local:setup: prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.sqlite.prisma && prisma db push --schema prisma/schema.sqlite.prisma && ts-node prisma/seed.ts
scripts.start:container: prisma db push --schema prisma/schema.postgres.prisma --skip-generate && ts-node prisma/seed.ts && node dist/main.js
